title: Munshiganj imam held over alleged sexual assault of minor under pretext of 'jinn exorcism'
excerpt: Girl's family alleges he had been treating people for alleged jinn possession for years, raising concerns that others may also have been victimised
content:
Girl's family alleges he had been treating people for alleged jinn possession for years, raising concerns that others may also have been victimised

Police have arrested an imam in Munshiganj over allegations that he attempted to rape a 13-year-old girl under the pretext of "exorcising jinn".

The girl's mother had filed a case against Maulana Rezaul Bari, imam of Srinagar Bazar Central Jame Mosque, in connection with the incident. The accused would be sent to court today, said Srinagar Police Station Officer-in-Charge Mohammad Jewel Miah.

Further legal procedures were underway, he added.

According to the girl's relatives, they had approached the imam a few days earlier, believing that the girl was possessed by a jinn, and obtained amulets from him.

At around 10:00pm last night, the girl went to the imam’s house with her parents. Under the pretext of summoning the jinn, the accused allegedly switched off all the lights in a room and forcibly subjected her to sexual assault, they added.

Following a statement from the girl, police conducted a raid and arrested Bari.

The victim's relatives also alleged that the accused had been providing treatment for alleged jinn possession for several years. They also expressed concern that others might have been sexually assaulted by him but refrained from reporting the incidents for fear of losing their social standing.
